name: go-module-value-physical-compared-dirs-lexical
body: `absRestrict` resolves each `--module` value to its physical path, but `dirAllowed` still compares it against the lexical `filepath.Abs`/walk dirs, so a scan root whose own spelling differs physically from its canonical path is reconciled only for the module value, not the walked dir; today `go list -m` emits physical dirs and the CLI roots the walk at the canonicalised scan root. Upgrade when a `go list -m` Dir or a walk path can itself arrive symlink-spelled and diverge from the resolved module dir.
